notes.title: EMITIME @ East Asia Indie Games Celebration !
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022507/88ee478ebe18d48b0a34200c2df2fabdeace8c90.png"][/img][/p][p]I am happy to announce that EMITIME will be a part of the East Asia Indie Games Celebration for these two weeks!  [/p][p][/p][p]EMITIME is a rhythm-based deck-building game - where music is your strategy! and it combines rhythm, deck builder, and grid-based strategy to create something unique, and enjoyable! [/p][p][/p][p]Perform attacks and move around the grid to the rhythm and activate your skill cards to defeat enemies!  You can pick new cards as you encounter enemies during the battles, and equip yourself with powerful skills to defeat them all!  [/p][p][/p][p]EMITIME is currently still under active development, and we appreciate any sort of support! Feel free to follow our social media and join our Discord Community to get the latest development updates!! 

Thank you everyone! ^^[/p]
